title: MC Kings
description:
Official MC Kings Modpack.
Made for a private Minecraft project, it contains everything a Minecraft player needs.
body:
## ![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbc28d43cb9fa83bd1f95b176e619450ff1f78a9.png)


## About This Modpack
MC Kings started as a private project and was created as a modpack for a private Minecraft server.

It is designed to provide a solid foundation with better performance, improved graphics, and essential multiplayer features like voice chat and a fitting custom menu, while keeping the core Minecraft experience intact.

MC Kings is still a private server modpack project and is perfect for players who want a clean, optimized base that looks good, runs smoothly, and is easy to build upon.

## Features
- Strong performance optimizations for higher FPS
- Improved visuals without changing the vanilla feeling
- Smooth gameplay on low-end and high-end PCs
- Built-in voice chat for multiplayer
- Custom main menu matching the modpack style
- Useful quality-of-life features
- Clean and lightweight mod selection
- Perfect base for your own mod expansions
- Regularly maintained and optimized

## Why this Modpack?
Because it offers a solid performance foundation while still keeping the vanilla look and feel of Minecraft.

## Updates:
For every new private project, the modpack receives an update to the latest or second-latest full Minecraft version, but only for versions that add significant new content.

## Technical Details
- Optimized for high FPS and fast loading times
- Recommended: at least 3 GB RAM
- Runs on Fabric
- Compatible with most client and server setups
- Plug-and-Play

## Note:
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by Minecraft or Microsoft!
